summary: One update carrying two actions, both validated (valid, execution_requested true; effects: knowledge update on bb3ff1d8-knowledge-0 and create experiment). (1) Correction to the recovery-value family fact: clause (b) previously read that a reply whose value ballot is 'at most' the fabricated one is ignored, which contradicts both the adoption loop's >= test and the receipts in which peer replies at the same value ballot as the fabricated candidate are adopted and one of them replaces the owner's command. The clause now states the strict condition - a value ballot below the running candidate is ignored, equality is still adopted - which is exactly what clause (d) relies on, and the dependency list that the previous revision of the fact dropped was restored with the current revisions of the three entries (2b0dd5bd rev 4, cbbf11dd rev 3, ed76b573 rev 2). No measurement or conclusion changed. (2) Experiment request finishing the last named discriminator of question 0757162a: the tie-break probe (three peer replies, one carrying X and two empty at value ballot 0, owner recovering its own accepted instance) now runs all six delivery permutations, with the three added runs 2,3,4 and 4,3,2 (an empty reply at the trigger position) and 4,2,3 (empty first, command-carrying reply at the trigger position); three comparisons assert owner_cmds_len == 1 for those runs. Local native feedback (not a receipt) shows 2,4,3 / 3,4,2 / 2,3,4 / 4,3,2 dropping the command and 3,2,4 / 4,2,3 keeping it, i.e. the command survives exactly when the second delivered reply carries it, matching the four-order receipt already recorded. Earlier this turn the four-order mixed-set receipt was recorded into the interpretation, knowledge 2b0dd5bd and the family fact with the trigger observed as the delivery that replaces the bookkeeping object; the previous interpretation record still holds the two gap answers that the latest interpretation's own answers map does not repeat.
